title: Next scheduled tick
description: A job runs on a fixed grid of ticks at 0, step, 2*step, 3*step and so on. Given the current time n (n >= 0) and the grid spacing step (step >= 1), return the first grid tick that is strictly later than n. A time that lies exactly on a tick still moves on to the following tick.
notes: Strictly-later rule is the trap (on-tick inputs). Inputs are never negative; the largest test stays below 2^53 so TypeScript is exact.
